title: app-modernise Claude Code plugin
note: Commands generate the change on a working branch; review, push and raise the MR yourself.

pipeline.title: Generate the CI/CD pipeline
pipeline.does: Edits .gitlab-ci.yml from the organisation's golden templates: build gate, tests, version tagging, deploy, rollback and security-scan jobs.

helm.title: Scaffold a Helm deployment
helm.does: A Helm chart per environment and a pipeline that builds, scans, packages and deploys a containerised application.

unit.title: Uplift unit tests to 75% coverage
unit.does: Spec-driven unit tests per module with a JaCoCo 75% target and a mutation-testing gate.

acceptance.title: Generate acceptance tests
acceptance.does: Acceptance test scaffolds for Spring-based JVM applications; extends existing suites.

contract.title: Generate consumer contract tests
contract.does: Finds outbound API calls and the provider specs, and checks every consumed endpoint exists.

perf.title: Generate performance tests
perf.does: Performance test runner from Honeycomb data and infrastructure configuration.

ha.title: Enable HA on Kubernetes
ha.does: Pod Disruption Budget and pod anti-affinity for a Kubernetes Helm application.

openapi.title: Expose an OpenAPI spec
openapi.does: Wires Springfox or Springdoc, configures security exclusions and validates the resulting spec.

spring.title: Upgrade Spring Boot
spring.does: Deterministic Spring Boot upgrade for Maven applications, proven green before and after each hop.

assess.title: Pre-migration assessment
assess.does: Cited findings across 13 sections and the questions to settle before a migration starts. Read-only.

slo.title: Generate SLOs and burn alerts
slo.does: Honeycomb SLO Terraform for availability, errors and latency with burn alerts.
